topic.title: Coastal Change / Shoreline Management Plans / Relocation
topic.source_contract: shoreline management plan unit and approach, coastal erosion and flood evidence, Coastal Change Management Area, development lifetime, rollback or relocation, permissions, adaptation measures, construction and monitored coastal performance evidence

scope_guards: An SMP management approach is not a project-specific planning permission.
A CCMA boundary is not an automatic development refusal.
A coastal erosion map is not a parcel-specific failure date.
A defence strategy is not treated as funded construction.
Planning permission is not treated as completed adaptation works.
Completed works are not treated as maintained performance.
A single shoreline observation is not treated as a long-term trend.
No score or promotion is written without exact plan, permission, construction, maintenance and monitored change evidence.
